items.title: 9.2.2 Key Parts of a Business Plan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.2.2 (PDF 210-211), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Achhe business plan ke aam taur par kai aham hisse hote hain:

items: Executive Summary (chhota khulasa): aap ke business idea ka chhota sa overview (jaiza). Is mein hota hai ke karobar kya karta hai, aap ke goals kya hain aur unhein kaise hasil karenge. Ise plan ke sab se aham points ka khulasa samjhein.

Business Description (karobar ka taaruf): yeh batata hai ke karobar kis bare mein hai: kaunse products ya services denge, target customers (jin gahakon ko nishana banaya hai) kaun hain, aur aap ka karobar unique (sab se alag) kyun hai. Misal: lemonade stand shuru kar rahe hain to batayein ke mohalle ke logon ko taza thanda lemonade bechenge.

Market Analysis (market ko parakhna): yeh dikhata hai ke aap apni market samajhte hain. Research kar ke maloom karein ke potential customers (jo aap ke customer ban sakte hain) kaun hain, unhein kya chahiye aur competitors (muqabla karne wale karobar) kaun hain. Maslan pet-sitting (paaltu janwaron ki dekh bhaal) ka kaam shuru karna ho to maloom karein ke ilaqe mein kitne log paaltu janwar rakhte hain aur aur kaunsi pet-sitting services maujood hain.

Organization and Management (team aur kaam ka intezam): batayein ke karobar kaise organize hoga (kaun kya karega); team members aur un ke kaam (roles) likhein. Misal: school club bana rahe hain to batayein ke president, secretary aur baqi posts (ohdon) par kaun hoga.

Products or Services: batayein ke kya bech rahe hain ya kaunsi service de rahe hain, aur un ki khoobiyan (features) aur faide (benefits) kya hain. Misal: tuition service shuru karein to batayein ke aap ke sabaq students ke grades kaise behtar karenge.

Marketing and Sales Strategy: is hisse mein tafseel hoti hai ke customers kaise layenge aur kaise saath rakhenge; marketing ke tareeqe aur sales ke tactics (tareeqe) likhein. Maslan crafts (haath se bani cheezon) ka karobar ho to batayein ke social media aur local fairs (maqami mele) se products kaise bechenge.

Financial Plan (paise ka plan): paise se jure apne goals aur unhein hasil karne ka tareeqa likhein; budget, kitna paisa chahiye (funding needs) aur kitni aamdani ki umeed hai (expected revenue), is ki tafseel dein. Misal: agar saaman khareedne ke liye $100 chahiye to batayein ke yeh paisa kaise jama karenge aur badle mein kitna kamane ki umeed hai.
Business Description (kitab ki aakhri misal: chai dhaba): "Hamara chai dhaba achhi qisam ki patti aur riwayati tareeqe se taza bani chai dega. Hamara stall local bazaar ke qareeb lagega."

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab aakhri bullet mein 'Business Description' dobara likhti hai. Yeh koi naya hissa nahi, balke chai dhabe ke liye business description likhne ki ek misal hai. Is liye business plan ke asal hisse saat hain. (9.2.2.2 ki Class Activity mein aathwan 'Appendix' bhi hai, yaani aakhir mein izafi maloomat ka hissa, jo sirf zaroorat ho to lagaya jata hai.) Financial Plan ki misal dollar ($100) mein hai; apne plan mein aap rupay (Rs.) likhenge.

blocks.prompt: Business plan banane ke aham qadam bataiye (short question 3) aur har qadam kyun zaroori hai, samjhaiye (long question 2).
blocks.explanation: Qadam: idea tay kar ke Executive Summary; Business Description; Market Analysis; Organization and Management (team); Products or Services ki tafseel; Marketing and Sales Strategy; Financial Plan. Har qadam zaroori hai: summary parhne walon ko jaldi convince (qail) karti hai; description aur products batate hain ke aap kya denge; market analysis asal demand (log kitna khareedna chahte hain) aur competitors dikhata hai; team batati hai ke kaam kaun karega; marketing batati hai ke customers kaise milenge; aur financial plan dikhata hai ke karobar apna kharcha utha sakta hai ya nahi aur kitna paisa chahiye.

items: Saat hisse: Executive Summary, Business Description, Market Analysis, Organization and Management, Products or Services, Marketing and Sales Strategy, Financial Plan.
